note: Picture cards. 'story' is the memory line; 'picture' describes what public/mnemonics/<codepoint>.svg shows. A picture is shown to children only when 'approved' is true: a parent or designer sets it after looking at the card. Characters without an entry get a generated line and are queued in content/generated/picture-queue.json.
